I am a **Research Assistant** at [PenTAG](https://medicine.exeter.ac.uk/phss/research/pentag/).

I appraise health economic evidence and model submitted by clients as part of health technology assessment (HTA) submissions to the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) in the UK. Additionally, I am also involved in research on health economic modelling methods and applications.
